GraceRequirements.Annotation: A planned Windows desktop application for safely triaging user-selected folders through deterministic rules, local metadata, optional content extraction, and optional on-device AI classification.
GraceRequirements.Keywords: Windows desktop, file inbox, local-first, file triage, deterministic rules, local AI, reversible operations

Goals.Goal: Turn user-selected folders, starting with Downloads, into a local reviewable inbox that classifies files, suggests destinations, and applies only user-authorized operations.

Users.User: Windows users who need a reliable way to triage downloaded and other incoming files, including users managing work documents.

Constraints.Constraint: Watch and operate only in folders explicitly selected by the user.
Never silently delete, overwrite, or execute files. Preview planned operations, record a local journal, and support undo for supported operations.
Treat file names and contents as untrusted data. AI output is advisory, and uncertain classifications require user review.
Keep core functionality local and usable without a cloud account or AI provider.
Apply deterministic rules first; use optional semantic classification only when content context is useful.
